title: Hong Kong LCSD says hackers accessed SmartPLAY; data of around 90,000 Leisure Link accounts involved
date_note: Both RTHK pages are dated 27 November and give no earlier day; the English page says LCSD was informed by the contractor on Thursday (26 November).
org: Leisure and Cultural Services Department (LCSD), SmartPLAY
geo_basis: LCSD, the Hong Kong government department that runs SmartPLAY; no city-level victim location stated
summary: LCSD's notice on the government news site says its outsourced contractor reported hackers illegally accessed SmartPLAY. Preliminary findings involve personal data of about 90,000 Leisure Link accounts: date of birth, phone number, address, gender and email address. LCSD says no identity document data is involved, and it has reported the case to police and regulators.
plain: Hong Kong's LCSD says hackers illegally accessed the SmartPLAY booking system. Data of about 90,000 Leisure Link accounts is involved, including date of birth, phone number, address, gender and email address.
exec: LCSD says about 90,000 Leisure Link accounts are involved in the SmartPLAY intrusion and the case is reported to police and regulators.
action: LCSD advises users to ignore verification-code emails they did not request, and to reset a forgotten password in person with a Hong Kong ID card at a venue with a Smart Self-service Station or a district leisure services office.

sources.name: news.gov.hk (HKSAR Government): SmartPLAY accessed illegally by hackers
RTHK (Chinese): LCSD says contractor has taken measures against hackers, SmartPLAY operates normally
RTHK (English): 90,000 users compromised in SmartPLAY data breach

evidence.quote: 初步調查顯示，SmartPLAY的「重新啟動Leisure Link帳戶」功能被黑客非法進入，涉及約九萬名Leisure Link帳戶的個人資料，包括出生日期、電話號碼、地址、性別和電郵地址，以及其中約1,500名用戶的姓名。
